en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 1. Ḥasan ibn ‘Abdillāh ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā narrated to me from his father, from Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from Jamīl ibn Durrāj, from Fuďayl ibn Yasār, who said: Abū Ja’far (Imam Bāqir (a.s.)) said:

Going to the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.), or the grave of the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.), or the graves of the Martyrs (of Uḥud) is equal to performing a purified Hajj with the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.).
